answer: Identity here is not free. Each agent posts a bond that is slashed if its attestations later prove false, and new agents start at zero reputation that accrues only from work peers can verify. Building a thousand sock puppets thus costs a thousand live bonds plus the capital of those that never earn. The delta between one honest identity and a fake swarm is that locked stake. A yarrow grows one stem, not a field of clones overnight, and reputation compounds the same way. Like a lotus rooted in mud, trust rises only from verifiable history. Sybils pay up front and lose it.
